# dagsterplus_service_user_organization_grant (Resource)

Manages an organization-level permission grant for a Dagster+ service user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_service_user_organization_grant" "ci_bot" {
  service_user_id = dagsterplus_service_user.ci_bot.id
  grant           = "ADMIN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_user_id` (String) The ID of the service user to grant access.

### Optional

- `custom_role_id` (String) The ID of a custom role to assign. Exactly one of grant or custom_role_id must be set.
- `grant` (String) Organization-level permission. For any non-admin role use custom_role_id with an organization-scoped custom role. Exactly one of grant or custom_role_id must be set. Valid values: `ADMIN`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (the service_user_id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an organization-level grant for a service user using the service_user_id.
terraform import dagsterplus_service_user_organization_grant.example <service_user_id>
```
